mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% over two consecutive months signals a tightening cycle that raises discount rates and reduces present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when this trigger is met, or the median return is not statistically different from zero at 90% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) exceeding 2% coincident with a housing starts (HOUST) drop of more than 10% in the prior quarter signals weakening aggregate demand, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY change < -2% AND HOUST QoQ change < -10%
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes, or the average return is not significantly negative at 95% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly unemployment rate increase of at least 0.4 percentage points for three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises by >= 0.4pp for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when this trigger is met, or the trigger fires but returns are positive more than 30% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) of more than 1% over three consecutive months indicates contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate earnings and increases recession risk, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 35% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not statistically different from zero at 90% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS above their respective 12-month moving averages signals a stagflationary environment where inflation and restrictive policy co-occur, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both proxies exceed their 12-month moving averages, or the event occurs without negative returns more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in real personal income (proxied by PAYEMS growth) of at least 0.5% over three consecutive months signals strengthening consumer balance sheets and higher spending power, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS monthly growth >= 0.5% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when this trigger is met, or the trigger fires but returns are negative more than 30% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous fall in both UNRATE and PAYEMS over two consecutive months indicates a dual deterioration in labor market participation and employment, which reduces aggregate demand and profit expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE AND PAYEMS both decline for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both UNRATE and PAYEMS decline for two months, or the event occurs without negative returns more than 35% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly decline in real retail sales (proxied by RSAFS) of more than 2% for four consecutive months signals a broad-based collapse in consumer spending, which depresses corporate revenues and earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 30% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not statistically different from zero at 95% confidence.
